## What this does

Runs the second whole-repo human-facing documentation refresh (the first was
P22.1): the `refresh-repo-docs` detector plus a claim-by-claim audit of every
in-scope human-facing doc against code/run/public evidence at HEAD. Since P22.1
the chain landed go-live (GCP deploy 2026-09-15, go-public executed 2026-09-16,
domain live 2026-09-23, national publish 2026-09-24, republish 2026-09-27),
P25–P31, and all of Round 10 — the drift was concentrated exactly where
expected: the docs still described the pre-launch "nothing is deployed / no
live fetch" posture. Audit + fixes are recorded in
`docs/build/reports/DOCS_REFRESH_REPORT_R10.md`.

**Drift fixed (file → claim):**
- `README.md` — "not a running service / nothing deployed / no source fetched
  live" → deployed + public at `surveillancegraph.org` (launch/republish records
  cited) with the honest Round-10 bounds: provisional-policy candidate
  **staging-only** (`D-R10-PUBLISH-1` OPEN), intake `operational=false`/503,
  evaluation deferred, dossiers `mechanical_complete`/`review.status=not_run`;
  spec stats → 9,377 lines / 715 ids / Part XI (§55) / 144 ADRs; 12 → 20
  registered connectors; Releases § points at the current P33.6 integration
  plan (`v0.1.0` still untagged — REL.1 skipped-by-operator).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — same deployment/live-fetch drift; "Known limitations"
  rewritten to the real owed register; the stale "MapLibre island not built"
  line corrected (P27.9/ADR-097/134); two references to the moved
  `PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md` repaired to `reports/`; a bounded post-Phase-21
  chain summary added.
- `ops/README.md` — "no cloud-specific config" scoped (the `ops/gcp/` home
  exists — ADR-075/081); "Go-public — Deferred" rewritten as the executed
  record; both moved-path references repaired; the Round-10 `sig-ops` verb
  families documented with honest offline/staging/credentialed labels.
- `ops/gcp/README.md` — dated append: the "no real apply" gate text kept as the
  authoring record; the apply ran under ADR-081 (Cloud SQL + Cloud Run).
- `web/README.md` — the absolute "no client JavaScript" claim qualified: zero-JS
  binds public content pages; three opt-in islands (`/map/`, `/network/`,
  `/search/`) + `/curate/**` carry explicit budgets (ADR-068/097/134); route
  inventory updated.
- `docs/README.md` / `docs/governance/README.md` — the missing `evaluation/`
  row added; governance count eight → ten with the intake packet + opinion
  drafts rows and their own recorded statuses.
- `docs/build/README.md` — BUILD_INDEX row range 1-66 → 1-199.
- `docs/build/reports/current/` — regenerated via `current_projection.py` (was
  projecting the P33.3-era control state).

**History preserved:** dated records kept verbatim (P22.1 report, the Phase-21
CHANGELOG blockquote, OPERATIONAL_READINESS §(a)–(e) snapshot, every
runs/pr/readouts entry, the append-only registers, generated spec + ADR index).
Governing ADRs are named inline where the architecture changed (ADR-075/081
deployment; 097/134 islands; 132/133/144 releases; 135 intake; 137–139
dossiers; 142 deferred evaluation; 145 spec reconciliation).
